purpose: Independent reproducibility check of the fixed primary PPG-to-BP model; not a new model-selection run
comparators: previous repeated-CV estimate for the same model family
success_rule: All five folds finish without patient overlap; OOF model MAE is lower than the training-fold population-mean baseline for both SBP and DBP; results remain directionally compatible with the prior 15-fit estimate.
reporting_rule: This run is a reproducibility check and must not replace the prespecified repeated-CV primary result.
